name: @one-source/docs-mcp

tools.name: 1s_search_docs
tools.description: Search the OneSource documentation by keyword. Returns the top matching sections from the docs site.

query.description: Search query: keywords to match against documentation sections

tools.name: 1s_get_api_overview
tools.description: High-level summary of the OneSource REST API: operation count, tags, supported networks, payment protocols, and a few sample endpoints.

tools.name: 1s_list_endpoints
tools.description: List OneSource REST API endpoints, optionally filtered by tag. Returns method, path, price, and one-line summary.

family.description: Optional product family filter: `chain-rpc` (live EVM RPC), `deepstate` (Robinhood Chain order-book market data), or `standard-reserve` (The Standard Reserve / TSR). Case-insensitive.

tools.name: 1s_get_endpoint_reference
tools.description: Full reference for one OneSource REST API endpoint: parameters, request body, example response, payment info, use cases, and a curl example.

endpoint.description: Either an operationId (e.g. `chainAllowance`) or a path (e.g. `/api/chain/allowance` or `chain-allowance`).

tools.name: 1s_search_use_cases
tools.description: Find OneSource endpoints by natural-language use case. Searches the x-use-cases annotation plus summary and keywords.

query.description: Natural-language description of what you want to do (e.g., "check NFT ownership", "decode a transaction").

tools.name: 1s_list_networks
tools.description: List the networks the OneSource REST API routes, as declared by the OpenAPI spec.

tools.name: 1s_get_payment_info
tools.description: OneSource REST API payment info: protocols (x402, MPP), price range, recipient address. Pass an endpoint to get per-endpoint specifics.

endpoint.description: Optional operationId or path. Omit for a global summary.

tools.name: 1s_get_authentication_guide
tools.description: Authenticating to the OneSource REST API: Bearer key (subscription at app.onesource.io/signup), x402 (USDC on Base), MPP (USDC.e on Tempo). When to use which.
